blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · SUPERHUMAN Pump has 0 mg caffeine, so …
blocks_element.text:
SUPERHUMAN Pump has 0 mg caffeine, so it can be stacked with SUPERHUMAN Burn if you want more pump and focus without adding extra stimulants. Burn already has 304 mg of caffeine, so the main thing to watch is your overall tolerance to Burn itself.
Best way to start: try 1 scoop of Burn with 1/2 scoop of SPump first, then adjust from there.
If you train at night, the Burn may be too much because of the caffeine, so Pump alone is usually the better move.
